_note: Per-locale tool SEO seed for the ClearLight Tools overhaul. fixed = the per-locale building blocks the templates compose: free/freeOnline (title prefix), conn+tail (description frame around the verb and the localized tool name), homeH1 (home headline). cats[cat] = the localized long-tail category seoName used for the category/all <title> and H1 (modifier + secondary intent, e.g. 'Image Tools & Converters'), NOT the short nav label. tools[id] = { action (2-3 word core action for the <title>, Title Case in EN), verb (verb-opening function phrase for the meta description), titleName (optional concise noun-form title keyword in ANY locale, e.g. 'Image Compressor' for compress-image; the H1/nav keep the display name) }. EN baseline: tool title <=65 cps (rich form, else 'Free [name] | brand', else '[name] | brand' fallback), tool description 135-158 cps. Brand separator is a pipe ' | ' (full-width '｜' for CJK); brand stays verbatim 'ClearLight Tools'. Composed by src/seo/compose.mjs and gated by scripts/check-tool-seo.mjs.
